releaseNotes:
- Auto-clear stale git index.lock and retry Send/commit when another git process left a lock
- Serialize git commands per repo to prevent concurrent status/add lock races
- Deploy workspace no longer auto-connects an unrelated FTP profile when the project has none assigned
- Session Manager and Terminal SSH profile lists refresh live after connection edits
